question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Fierce
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. **"Furious"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fierce**: (भयंकर) - Having or displaying an intense or ferocious aggressiveness.

 
 
• **Example**: The company has faced fierce competition from its rivals.
 
 
 
• **Furious:** (क्रोधित) - Extremely angry.
 
 
• **Example**: She was furious when she found out about the betrayal.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Furious"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lame**: (लंगड़ा) - (of a person or animal) unable to walk normally because of an injury or illness affecting the leg or foot.

 
 
• **Example**: The injured bird was lame and couldn't fly.
 
 
 
• **Lavish**: (शानदार) - Sumptuously rich, elaborate, or luxurious.
 
 
• **Example**: They planned a lavish wedding reception.
 
 
 
• **Strange**: (अजीब) - Unusual or surprising in a way that is unsettling or hard to understand.
 
 
• **Example**: It's strange that she didn't show up for her party.
